description: Use before an agent pays an address: one call screens the payee address against OFAC SDN, UK and EU wallet entries (sanctions lists), adds the rule-based wallet risk (EVM). Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /check/payee, $0.015 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. One payee address (0x EVM or Solana): sanctions wallet entries plus, for EVM, the rule-based wallet risk; for a person or company name use check_counterparty; for a list of addresses use sanctions_screening_batch. With an access key (Authorization: Bearer p0k_..., buy at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) the tool pays the call itself, returns the data and deducts the price. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.
